thread:
Marc: Heads up — PR #18321 is ready but we're seeing a macOS matrix flake. There's a rebase window at 16:00 UTC (~2h). Can we gate landing until then? Need one more approval + a CI rerun. @Sara @Raj @Anya
ci-bot: Build 18321.1 failed on macos-latest (test-suite). Suspected flaky test: `tests/cli/test_init.py::test_config_load`. Rerun command: `/ci rerun 18321.1`
Sara: I can approve once mac is green. Do we have oncall eyes? @Leo
Raj: I'll kick a rerun and try to repro locally.
Anya: quick Q — does this touch any inference runtime kernels or canary routing? If yes, let's avoid landing during the 18:00 deploy-freeze.
Marc: It's a client/SDK change (rate-limit tweak + small retry logic). Not touching runtime kernels, but it does touch canary routing for Dedicated. I'd prefer to land before freeze but after the rebase window.
ops-bot: Reminder: nightly deploy freeze 18:00 — 20:00 UTC for the db migration. Any infra-impacting changes should land before 18:00 or be postponed.
Leo: OK — I can give approval after green. Ping me when the rerun completes.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Raj: `/ci rerun 18321.1` — queued on macos runners.
ci-bot: Build 18321.1 (macos-latest) — PASSED. All checks green: unit, integration, e2e-smoke.
Sara: Approving now :white_check_mark:
Marc: Thanks — @Leo @Raj plan: we hold for the rebase window (16:00 UTC). Can we aim to merge at 16:05 and tag canary?
Raj: Yep. I'll do the rebase at 15:55, run a quick e2e at 16:00, and hand off for merge.
Anya: Please add a one-line rollback runbook to the PR description (how to revert and how to abort canary).
Marc: Done — added rollback steps + canary monitor link: https://console.example.com/canaries/18321
Olivia: left a tiny nit comment about a log message (non-blocking). :sparkles:
Marc: Addressed and pushed. @ops-bot — can you lift the auto-merge hold at 16:04 so Leo can merge at 16:05?
ops-bot: Auto-merge holds are enforced until 16:06 UTC due to scheduled blackout policy. Manual merge allowed after 16:06 if oncall approves.
Leo: I'll merge manually at 16:06 if everything looks green. (+1 :thumbsup:)
Marc: Thanks all — I'll watch the canary for 30m after merge and post results here.
Raj: I'll stay available for quick rollback if needed.
Sara: Great coordination — thanks team.
Marc: (logging) final note: rebase done at 15:56, merge scheduled 16:06 per ops-bot, canary tag `canary/18321-ops`
ci-bot: Deploy to canary started at 16:07 UTC — monitor: https://console.example.com/canaries/18321/events
Marc: Canary stable after 10m smoke. No errors in traces. Marking ship window successful. :tada:
